_meta.description: Audit trail for demo patient profiles. Every biomarker value is grounded in a published dataset reference.
_meta.ruo_notice: Research Use Only. Synthetic data derived from published reference distributions. Not real patient data.

NHANES.description: Levine 2018 PhenoAge paper. NHANES III/IV reference distributions used for biomarker sampling.

LonGenity.description: Ashkenazi Jewish centenarian families. APOE e4/e4 frequency and FOXO3/CETP/KLOTHO protective allele data.

MESA.description: Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis. ASCVD risk calibration, ApoB/LDL reference values.

InCHIANTI.description: Italian aging cohort. Sarcopenia biomarker reference values (albumin, testosterone, grip strength).

BLSA.description: Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging. Longitudinal biomarker trajectory reference.

DNA_Repair_Panel.description: BRCA1/2, MLH1/2, MUTYH, ATM, CHEK2 pathways. Cancer risk layer.
